help.title: How it works
help.description: Find an available study space in just a few steps.
help.findDescription: Browse available study rooms and see how many seats are currently free. Choose a suitable room.
help.checkInDescription: Scan the QR code or NFC tag at the room entrance. Select whether you are checking in alone or as a group.
help.sessionDescription: Your session lasts two hours. You can extend it if needed.
help.checkOutDescription: Check out when leaving so your seats become available again. Your session also ends automatically when it expires.
help.noticeDescription: Lernraum is not a reservation system. Displayed occupancy is based on recorded check-ins and check-outs.
